description: The truth-set map sends join of formula classes to union of their truth sets.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.truthSet_sup.{u} {α : Type u}
  (x y : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.FormulaAlgebra α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.truthSet (x ⊔ y) =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.truthSet x ∪
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.truthSet y
